_comment: Thresholds for scripts/check_delivery.py, from DataPRD1019 v1.1 section 6 (UMI) and docs/UMI_delivery_checklist.md. Relative paths resolve against vlm_scripts_reports/.
_expected_fps_note: GoPro HERO12 at 59.94 fps; a different rate is a WARN, unequal rates between the three views (or vs meta) a FAIL (V1).
_vlm_note: A VLM count below min_cycles fails the recording only with n_repetitions_confidence >= vlm_fail_confidence; otherwise REVIEW. A manual count always decides.
_strict_note: Equal length is exact: the three videos and both gripper csvs have the SAME frame count (0 difference); durations and start times within half a frame. 14_export_rhoda.py cuts every file to the episode's steps, so a difference means a broken export. A timeline gap above 1.5 frame periods (--deep) is a dropped frame.
_out_note: out_csv names the per-recording CSV; _summary.csv, _failures.csv, _deliverable.csv and _report.md are written next to it with the same stem.
_extra_checks_note: D6 duplicate: identical left + right gripper csv in two recordings (the copy outside a station folder, or the later path, fails). W7: calibration (fx fy cx cy) per view vs the one most recordings of the station use; left/right exchanged is a WARN. W8: sync.method without sync_method_expected. W9: >= gripper_jump_count frame-to-frame width jumps > gripper_jump_m (marker tracking glitches). W10: width unchanged longer than gripper_flat_s (tracking lost, value held; or passive gripper). W11: any view below min_video_kbps (blocked or dark lens?).
